# SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - databook nomenclature for the fictional Widgetron.
# Real projects accrue one of these per IP block, in the project repo.
# One identifier per line, then '#' and the public reference that uses the
# name; a line that is only a comment is skipped; matching is case-insensitive.
WIDGETRON_CTRL        # Widgetron databook (invented), register table 2
WIDGETRON_STATUS      # Widgetron databook (invented), register table 2
CTRL_SOFT_RESET       # Widgetron databook (invented), CTRL bit 0
STATUS_RESET_BUSY     # Widgetron databook (invented), STATUS bit 0
